title: sphaeralcea americana
intro: Sphaeralcea americana, commonly known as the Desert Marigold, is a flowering plant species native to the western United States and northern Mexico. The Desert Marigold is valued for its bright yellow and orange flowers, which bloom from February to May, and its edible and medicinal properties. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including wounds, fever, and digestive problems, due to its therapeutic actions of antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Sphaeralcea americana include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its health benefits and potential therapeutic applications.
